name: Li Ping
bio: Li Ping (李邴; Li Bing; 1085–1146) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 汉宫春 (Han gong chun)
poems.author: Li Ping
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
潇洒江梅，向竹梢疏处，横两三枝。
东君也不爱惜，雪压霜欺。
无情燕子，怕春寒、轻失花期。
却是有，年年塞雁，归来曾见开时。
清浅小溪如练，问玉堂何似，茅舍疏篱。
伤心故人去後，冷落新诗。
微云淡月，对江天、分付他谁。
空自忆，清香未减，风流不在人知。
